name: Order X-ray
tagline: A read-only X-ray of a sales or purchase order: every stage at a glance, and why it is stuck.

permissions.sidePanel: Shows Order X-ray in the browser's side panel, next to D365.
permissions.storage: Your settings only: the thresholds per order type, the Follow D365 switch, and per D365 environment the table ids that charges need. No order data.
permissions.contextMenus: One Open in Order X-ray item in the browser's right-click menu.
